worldcombat.skill.explosion.summary: Lights a visible fuse and creeps toward the chosen nearby point; when the fuse burns out it detonates where the body actually stands. Every enemy in the ring takes a heavy hit and is hurled outward and lifted, leaving a charred crater. A wall stops the body but not the fuse; being knocked down mid-fuse voids the move and no second blast follows. Even a blast that hits no one takes the user down. Charged blast is bigger and longer, snap blast is faster.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.0: Creep into a crowd on a lit fuse and badly hurt a whole ring
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.1: Hurl every close foe far outward
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.2: Use the readable fuse to drive foes off the landing point
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.3: Leave a lasting crater before going down
On detonation the body's real position is the centre: every enemy in the ring takes one hit for about %1$s explosion damage (up to %2$s targets). The target's defence, type and crits settle on the hit (a Ghost is immune to the blow, but the user still faints).
The blast reaches %1$s blocks; that ring is the ground it covers.

After commit the fuse is lit and the body creeps toward the chosen point within %1$s blocks; the fuse burns out after %2$s s (creep speed %3$s blocks/tick). Reaching the point or hitting a wall stops the body but the fuse keeps burning, and the blast centre is the actual stopping point. Being knocked down mid-fuse voids the move, with no second blast.
Those caught are hurled %1$s blocks outward and lifted at %2$s blocks/tick.
Blast the surface inside the ring into charred blackstone, up to %2$s blocks, and restore it after %1$s seconds; water, lava, bedrock and the like are left untouched.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.charged.on: Charged blast: power about x1.12, the blast spreads x1.12, the crater lasts x1.6 and the fuse is +3, at wind-up +6 and cooldown +14 (longer and easier to interrupt or dodge).
worldcombat.skill.explosion.charged.off: Snap blast: power about x0.95, the blast narrows to x0.95 and cooldown is -8, so it comes out faster with a shorter crater.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.timing: Pick a nearby point within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s s wind-up it spends %3$s PP and a %4$s s cooldown is committed on cast. The wind-up can be interrupted, and an interrupt costs no PP and no cooldown. The user faints once it is used.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.preference.a: Off (default): the companion never volunteers this move. On: it only proposes it when the blast point can cover enough foes - it lights the fuse, creeps in and goes down. Below the desperation threshold the bar drops to one target. A manual order always fires it.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.preference.c: On (charged blast): power about x1.12, the blast spreads x1.12, the crater lasts x1.6 and the fuse is +3, at wind-up +6 and cooldown +14 - the longer you charge the more you get, but the easier it is to interrupt or dodge. Off (snap blast): power about x0.95, the blast narrows to x0.95 and cooldown is -8, so it comes out faster with a shorter crater. Either way the user goes down.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion will not walk in to detonate; it is a move for inside the ring.
At least this many visible, living targets must be coverable by the blast point before it detonates; raise it for surrounded-only use, set it to 1 to detonate at a single target.
Below this fraction of its own health the companion lowers the detonation threshold to one target; higher makes it go down fighting sooner.
